entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data to the network, such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates transmission of protocol data to the network using the PCO IE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The PCO IE is included when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data to the network.
The PCO IE is used when extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or network.
